indicators.scope: one selected terminal-reaching route of one admit-canonical-circuit-blueprint execution, not the union of all declared routes
indicators.calculation: completed required cells, traversed required executable transitions, and satisfied required convergence products for the selected terminal-reaching route divided by all cells and edges required by that same selected route, where: selected branch variants determine route membership; every declared member of an encountered fan-out set is required; every declared product of an encountered convergence set is required; cells and edges reachable only through unselected independent branches are excluded from both numerator and denominator; bounded-return iteration instances are counted according to their declared iteration authority; and missing testimony for a route-required cell or edge fails closed rather than reducing the denominator
indicators.freshness: bound to the current execution receipt

objectives.target: 1.0 for the selected terminal-reaching route before that route's terminal disposition is admitted

appliedReviewFindings: The exact feature, canonical blueprint candidate, and design-partition ledger are approved as one reviewed design boundary.
authorizes: The canonical blueprint review obligation for the exact reviewed boundary is satisfied.
The exact design-partition ledger candidate may close deterministic obligation-coverage inspection.
